payload.summary: 2x button shipped: Clear/Rebet/2x/DEAL, keyboard X, tab order 12-15 with header and panel shifted to 16-20. Codex APPROVE first pass (run 51fspn93) with the money paths checked specifically: planDoubleWager and doubleBetHistory clone their inputs, the previous! assertion is provably safe, a valid plan costs exactly twice the selected history, betLayout.rebet() revalidates every chip and rolls back the whole layout on refusal, so h7g4w2rg stays shut and applyBankrollDelta cannot be driven negative. It noted one piece of future hardening rather than a finding: no test covers a divergence between a successful plan and a failed live rebet, because no current execution path can create one.
